explicit_requirements: Starting an arithmetic practice attempt returns its identifier and question.
A learner can submit an answer for that attempt and revisit the result using its identifier.
The revisited result shows the submitted answer and whether it was correct.
An unknown attempt returns not found.
ambiguities: Whether an answer may be replaced by a later submission for the same attempt is unspecified; the current update behavior does not establish that policy.
The learner-visible result before an answer has been submitted is unspecified; current null values are not a stated product requirement.

scenarios.name: Start an identifiable practice attempt
scenarios.behavior: Starting an attempt returns an identifier for that attempt and its arithmetic question.
scenarios.reason: The task explicitly specifies both returned pieces of information.

scenarios.name: Revisit the submitted answer and correctness
scenarios.behavior: After submitting an answer for an attempt, revisiting that attempt by its returned identifier shows that answer and accurately indicates whether it answers the question correctly.
scenarios.reason: The task explicitly requires submission followed by retrieval of the answer and correctness.

scenarios.name: Keep attempt answers separate
scenarios.behavior: Submitting an answer for one attempt does not set or replace the answer belonging to a different attempt.
scenarios.reason: The task explicitly requires attempts to keep their answers separate.

scenarios.name: Report unknown attempts
scenarios.behavior: Accessing an attempt that does not exist reports not found.
scenarios.reason: The task explicitly specifies the unknown-attempt behavior.
